summary: No first-property settings can be recommended from these calls. They are unsuccessful sales outreach and phone-routing attempts; no authorized GRC stakeholder discussed or approved Entrata configuration. The existing GRC phone menu is observable, but GRC never decided whether Entrata should replace it, integrate with it, or leave it unchanged.

questions.question: Should the first property use Entrata's default Leasing AI IVR Menu, reproduce GRC's existing custom phone tree, or retain a third-party phone system? Pending a client decision, use the catalog default: Leasing AI IVR Menu.
questions.why: GRC currently routes callers through a company directory and separate options for owners, tenants, applications, HR, and operator assistance. These recordings establish the current workflow but do not authorize an Entrata configuration.
